title: Webhook Registry Schema v1
description: Schema for a webhook_registry row used by the Central Webhook Dispatch routing system

event_type.description: Event type used for routing (must align with event.schema.json `type` pattern)

target_workflow_logical_id.description: Repo logical workflow ID (typically matches workflows_catalog.yaml `id`)

target_workflow_name.description: n8n workflow name (stable under GitOps upsert-by-name)

cached_n8n_workflow_id.description: Optional cached n8n workflow id (not relied on for correctness)

description.description: Human-readable description of this event route

is_active.description: Whether the event route is active

payload_schema_type.description: Optional schema type for payload validation (e.g., contact, infra_deploy)

required_payload_fields.description: Array of required field paths (dot-paths) enforced against event.payload
